# Apollo's Original MMORPG Item Database

> Original fantasy MMORPG equipment database. All names, setting details, factions, regions, and lore in this file are newly invented. Items acquired by Apollo must be selected from this database. Item levels and stats follow the requested rank bands and scaling guide.

## Rank Bands

| Rank | Suggested level band |
|---|---:|
| F | Lv 1–10 |
| E | Lv 11–25 |
| D | Lv 26–40 |
| C | Lv 41–55 |
| B | Lv 56–70 |
| A | Lv 71–85 |
| S | Lv 86–100 |
| SS | Lv 101–120 |
| SSS | Lv 121–150 |

## Class List

Warrior, Knight, Berserker, Assassin, Ranger, Mage, Cleric, Summoner, Monk, Dual Swordsman.

# Rank F — Weapons — Warrior

*Warrior weapon identity: dependable close-combat arms built for adaptable offense and practical battlefield control. F-rank weapon ATK range: 5–15. All listed level requirements fall within Lv 1–10.*

## [WPN-WAR-F-001] Hearthward Shortblade — F

Type/Slot: One-handed sword / Main hand | Class: Warrior | Lv Req: 2

Base Stats: ATK 8

Bonus Stats: +1 STR

Effect: **Steady Guard** — after successfully deflecting an attack, gain +2 DEF for 4 seconds. Can trigger once every 10 seconds.

Requirements: Warrior class; minimum STR 4.

Set: None.

Binding/Durability: Tradable; 80/80 durability. Repairs use ordinary smithing services.

Source: Starter-town weaponsmith stock; also a low-chance drop from Brambleback Cutters in the Alder March.

Lore: Made from practical gray iron, the Hearthward is issued to watch recruits who cannot yet afford a proper longsword. Its brass pommel is stamped with a tiny flame, a reminder to hold the line until help arrives.

## [WPN-WAR-F-002] Rootsplitter Hatchet — F

Type/Slot: One-handed axe / Main hand | Class: Warrior | Lv Req: 4

Base Stats: ATK 11

Bonus Stats: +2 STR, −1 SEN

Effect: **Chop Through** — attacks against wooden shields, vines, and light wooden barriers deal 15% more damage. No bonus against creatures or metal armor.

Requirements: Warrior class; minimum STR 6.

Set: None.

Binding/Durability: Tradable; 75/75 durability.

Source: Quest reward for “Clearing the Old Footpath” in the village of Mossford; also sold by the Mossford timber camp quartermaster.

Lore: The broad wedge head is forged to split stubborn roots as readily as a bandit's shield. Its ash handle bears old notch marks from a forester who counted every trail he cleared.

## [WPN-WAR-F-003] Duskford Spear — F

Type/Slot: One-handed spear / Main hand; may pair with a small shield / Class: Warrior | Lv Req: 5

Base Stats: ATK 10

Bonus Stats: +1 AGI, +1 SEN

Effect: **Measured Reach** — the first melee strike against an enemy that has not yet reached you deals +10% damage. Does not trigger again on that target for 12 seconds.

Requirements: Warrior class; minimum AGI 5. Requires one hand free; cannot be used with a two-handed weapon.

Set: None.

Binding/Durability: Tradable; 70/70 durability.

Source: Craftable by a town spearwright from marsh ash and iron; uncommon reward from the Reedbank Patrol quest.

Lore: Its darkened shaft is treated with river oil to resist damp and splintering. Duskford patrols favor the weapon because a steady line of spearpoints can make a narrow bridge feel like a fortress.

## [WPN-WAR-F-004] Cairnmark Warhammer — F

Type/Slot: Two-handed warhammer / Main hand | Class: Warrior | Lv Req: 7

Base Stats: ATK 14

Bonus Stats: +2 STR, −1 AGI

Effect: **Ringing Impact** — a fully charged basic attack has a 10% chance to stagger a non-boss enemy for 1 second. Internal cooldown: 12 seconds per target.

Requirements: Warrior class; minimum STR 8; both hands required. A charged attack roots the wielder in place for 0.6 seconds.

Set: None.

Binding/Durability: Tradable; 65/65 durability.

Source: Drop from the Stonejaw Burrower in the abandoned quarry below Cairnmark; also obtainable as the final reward for the quarry-safety contract.

Lore: The head is a rough block of ironstone banded in steel, heavy enough to punish a careless swing. Quarry workers once used its duller twin to test whether a freshly cut wall was sound.

## [WPN-WAR-F-005] Wayfarer's Twin Edges — F

Type/Slot: Matched paired short swords / Main hand and off hand | Class: Warrior | Lv Req: 9

Base Stats: ATK 7 each (14 combined when both strikes hit; each blade is calculated separately)

Bonus Stats: +1 AGI, +1 STR

Effect: **Crossing Cut** — when both blades hit the same target within 1.5 seconds, the second hit deals +10% damage. The bonus cannot critically strike. Internal cooldown: 8 seconds.

Requirements: Warrior class; minimum AGI 7 and STR 6; requires both hands and both listed blades equipped. Does not grant an extra attack or bypass attack timing.

Set: None.

Binding/Durability: Tradable as a pair or individually; 60/60 durability per blade.

Source: Rare stock from the traveling smith caravan at Three-Road Market; alternatively, complete the “Lost Caravan Ledger” quest and choose the paired blades as your reward.

Lore: These slim, plain-edged blades were designed for caravan guards who needed room to draw in a crowded wagon train. Their maker etched one small road-marker on each guard so the pair can be recognized without ornament.

---

## Rank F — Weapons — Knight

*Knight weapon identity: defensive, disciplined arms suited to guarding allies and controlling space. F-rank weapon ATK range: 5–15. All listed level requirements fall within Lv 1–10.*

## [WPN-KNI-F-001] Gatewatch Arming Sword — F

Type/Slot: One-handed arming sword / Main hand | Class: Knight | Lv Req: 2

Base Stats: ATK 8

Bonus Stats: +1 VIT

Effect: **Watchful Set** — while a shield is equipped, gain +1 DEF. This modest bonus is always active and does not stack with another Watchful Set item.

Requirements: Knight class; minimum VIT 4; one hand free.

Set: None.

Binding/Durability: Tradable; 85/85 durability.

Source: Sold by the Gatewatch armorer in Bellstrand; also issued to new members of the town's volunteer watch.

Lore: Its straight blade and uncomplicated grip are designed for long shifts, not ceremony. The three shallow grooves near the guard mark the watch's promise to protect the road, the gate, and the people between them.

## [WPN-KNI-F-002] Bellstrand Pavise-Mace — F

Type/Slot: One-handed flanged mace / Main hand | Class: Knight | Lv Req: 4

Base Stats: ATK 10

Bonus Stats: +1 STR, +1 VIT

Effect: **Shieldline Tap** — when you block an attack with a shield, your next mace hit within 3 seconds deals +8% damage. Cooldown: 8 seconds.

Requirements: Knight class; minimum STR 5 and VIT 5; one hand free. The bonus requires a shield block and cannot trigger from a dodge.

Set: None.

Binding/Durability: Tradable; 80/80 durability.

Source: Reward for the “Hold the Bellstrand Causeway” defense quest; uncommon drop from causeway raiders.

Lore: The blunt crown is ringed with four low flanges, enough to bite through a wooden buckler without making the weapon unwieldy. Its leather-wrapped haft carries a faint smell of lamp oil from the watchtower stores.

## [WPN-KNI-F-003] Oathkeeper's Longsword — F

Type/Slot: Two-handed longsword / Main hand | Class: Knight | Lv Req: 6

Base Stats: ATK 13

Bonus Stats: +2 VIT, −1 AGI

Effect: **Interposed Guard** — after completing a charged attack, gain +2 DEF for 3 seconds. Cooldown: 12 seconds. The effect ends early if you switch weapons.

Requirements: Knight class; minimum VIT 7; both hands required. A charged attack slows movement by 20% while charging.

Set: None.

Binding/Durability: Tradable; 75/75 durability.

Source: Craftable by a Bellstrand swordsmith using local iron and a watch-oath token; the token is awarded for completing three public-defense contracts.

Lore: The fuller is broad and shallow, keeping the blade balanced enough for a trained guard to turn a strike aside. No noble house claims it; each sword is stamped with the name of the district that paid for its steel.

## [WPN-KNI-F-004] Pilgrim's Reach — F

Type/Slot: One-handed spear / Main hand; shield-compatible / Class: Knight | Lv Req: 7

Base Stats: ATK 11

Bonus Stats: +1 SEN, +1 VIT

Effect: **Keep Your Ground** — when an enemy enters melee range, gain +1 DEF for 3 seconds. Cooldown: 10 seconds. Triggers only while standing on solid ground.

Requirements: Knight class; minimum VIT 6 and SEN 4; one hand free. Cannot be used while a two-handed weapon is equipped.

Set: None.

Binding/Durability: Tradable; 70/70 durability.

Source: Pilgrim-road milestone chest near the White Reed Shrine; also sold by the shrine's quartermaster after the first road-escort quest.

Lore: The spear's pale haft is marked at regular intervals to help a bearer judge reach in fog. Travelers leave a thread tied below the head when they complete the road safely, and the oldest threads have faded almost white.

## [WPN-KNI-F-005] Hearthwarder's Buckler — F

Type/Slot: Shield / Off-hand | Class: Knight | Lv Req: 9

Base Stats: DEF 8

Bonus Stats: +2 VIT, +1 SEN

Effect: **Covering Angle** — after a successful block, one nearby ally within 2 meters gains +1 DEF for 2 seconds. Cooldown: 12 seconds; affects one ally only.

Requirements: Knight class; minimum VIT 8; requires an empty off-hand. A successful block still consumes the normal stamina cost and does not prevent guard-break effects.

Set: None.

Binding/Durability: Tradable; 65/65 durability.

Source: Quest reward from the Hearthward Refuge after completing “Three Minutes at the Door”; also obtainable from its weekly supply cache.

Lore: This small iron-rimmed shield is built to turn a blow away from the person standing beside its bearer. Its face bears no crest, only a shallow circle polished bright by the hands that carried it through the refuge's narrow entrance.

---

## Rank F — Weapons — Berserker

*Berserker weapon identity: forceful, high-commitment weapons that reward pressure while exposing openings if mistimed. F-rank weapon ATK range: 5–15. All listed level requirements fall within Lv 1–10.*

## [WPN-BER-F-001] Redwake Cleaver — F

Type/Slot: Two-handed greatsword / Main hand | Class: Berserker | Lv Req: 2

Base Stats: ATK 14

Bonus Stats: +2 STR, −1 SEN

Effect: **First Blood Rush** — after taking damage from an enemy, your next basic attack within 4 seconds deals +8% damage. Cooldown: 10 seconds. Does not trigger from self-inflicted damage.

Requirements: Berserker class; minimum STR 5; both hands required. A missed heavy attack briefly reduces movement speed by 10% for 1 second.

Set: None.

Binding/Durability: Tradable; 70/70 durability.

Source: Uncommon drop from the Redwake Boar in the Siltfen; also offered by the village smith after the “Boar at the Palisade” quest.

Lore: The blade's chipped spine is left deliberately rough, a reminder that a berserker's weapon is a tool, not a mirror. Redwake hunters say its rust-red stains are harmless bog iron, though the smith refuses to confirm it.

## [WPN-BER-F-002] Cragbite Maul — F

Type/Slot: Two-handed maul / Main hand | Class: Berserker | Lv Req: 4

Base Stats: ATK 15

Bonus Stats: +2 STR, −1 AGI

Effect: **Staggering Weight** — a fully charged hit has a 8% chance to stagger a non-boss enemy for 1 second. Cooldown: 14 seconds per target.

Requirements: Berserker class; minimum STR 7; both hands required. While charging, movement speed is reduced by 25%.

Set: None.

Binding/Durability: Tradable; 65/65 durability.

Source: Boss chest from the Cragbite Hollow event dungeon; low-chance drop from quarry stonebacks.

Lore: Its head is a single block of dark quarry iron wrapped in a cage of riveted bands. The first one was built to break a cave-in's loose stone, but it proved equally persuasive against anything that tried to hold a doorway.

## [WPN-BER-F-003] Splitthorn Hatchets — F

Type/Slot: Matched paired handaxes / Main hand and off hand | Class: Berserker | Lv Req: 5

Base Stats: ATK 6 each (12 combined when both strikes hit; each axe is calculated separately)

Bonus Stats: +1 STR, +1 AGI

Effect: **Chase the Opening** — after hitting an enemy with one axe, a hit with the other axe within 2 seconds deals +8% damage. Cooldown: 8 seconds. Does not grant an additional attack.

Requirements: Berserker class; minimum STR 5 and AGI 5; both hands required and both listed axes must be equipped.

Set: None.

Binding/Durability: Tradable as a pair or individually; 65/65 durability per axe.

Source: Craftable at the Splitthorn logging camp from two iron heads and seasoned alder hafts; also a reward for the “Clear the Stump Road” contract.

Lore: Each axe has a crescent notch near the heel, letting a practiced wielder catch and redirect a wooden haft. Their camp-made balance is imperfect by design: the smith insists a fighter should learn to adapt rather than blame the tool.

## [WPN-BER-F-004] Furnacehook Flail — F

Type/Slot: One-handed chain flail / Main hand | Class: Berserker | Lv Req: 7

Base Stats: ATK 12

Bonus Stats: +2 STR, −1 SEN

Effect: **Hook and Haul** — a hit against an enemy using a small shield reduces that shield's DEF bonus by 1 for 3 seconds. Cooldown: 12 seconds. Does not disarm or pull the target.

Requirements: Berserker class; minimum STR 7; one hand free. The chain requires room to swing; attacks against targets within arm's reach deal 10% less damage.

Set: None.

Binding/Durability: Tradable; 60/60 durability.

Source: Sold by the furnace-yard quartermaster in Kettlecross after completing the forge-yard sparring trial; uncommon drop from ash-bandit bruisers.

Lore: The short chain ends in a blunt, hooked iron weight made to snag a shield rim, not pierce flesh. Kettlecross trainees practice with it over straw dummies until they can feel the hook catch without looking.

## [WPN-BER-F-005] Last Ember Pike — F

Type/Slot: Two-handed war pick / Main hand | Class: Berserker | Lv Req: 10

Base Stats: ATK 15

Bonus Stats: +2 STR, +1 VIT, −1 AGI

Effect: **Crack the Guard** — against a blocking enemy, a charged hit deals +10% damage to the block's durability. It does not bypass the block or increase damage to the enemy directly. Cooldown: 12 seconds.

Requirements: Berserker class; minimum STR 8 and VIT 5; both hands required. Charging reduces movement speed by 20%.

Set: None.

Binding/Durability: Tradable; 60/60 durability.

Source: Final reward for “Embers Under the Old Kiln,” a level-10 public quest; may also appear in the weekly kiln-delver cache.

Lore: A narrow pick of blackened iron crowns a haft hardened in the last working kiln of Old Kettlecross. Its name comes from the stubborn coal that glowed beneath the ash after the settlement's great furnace was thought cold.

## Rank F — Weapons — Assassin

*Assassin weapon identity: light, precise weapons for quick entries, feints, and controlled exits. F-rank weapon ATK range: 5–15.*

## [WPN-ASN-F-001] Gloamneedle — F

Type/Slot: Dagger / Main hand | Class: Assassin | Lv Req: 2

Base Stats: ATK 7

Bonus Stats: +2 AGI

Effect: **Quiet Opening** — your first strike from stealth deals +10% damage. This bonus ends when you enter combat and cannot re-trigger on the same target for 20 seconds.

Requirements: Assassin class; minimum AGI 5.

Set: None.

Binding/Durability: Tradable; 65/65 durability.

Source: Sold by the Lantern Row outfitter; uncommon drop from dusk-moths in the Old Drain.

Lore: A narrow blade of dull gray steel that catches little light. The maker's mark is hidden beneath the dark leather grip, where only its owner is likely to find it.

## [WPN-ASN-F-002] Twinwick Knives — F

Type/Slot: Matched paired knives / Main hand and off hand | Class: Assassin | Lv Req: 4

Base Stats: ATK 5 each (10 combined when both strikes hit; each knife is calculated separately)

Bonus Stats: +2 AGI, +1 SEN

Effect: **Feinting Pair** — after a successful dodge, your next knife hit within 2 seconds gains +5% accuracy. Cooldown: 8 seconds.

Requirements: Assassin class; minimum AGI 6 and SEN 4; both hands required and both knives must be equipped.

Set: None.

Binding/Durability: Tradable as a pair or individually; 60/60 durability per knife.

Source: Reward from the Lantern Row “Two Steps, No Sound” test; may be crafted by a cutler with two wicksteel blanks.

Lore: One blade is slightly longer than the other, a deliberate mismatch that helps the bearer judge which hand is forward by feel. Their paired hilts are wrapped in pale cord once used to mark safe alleys during the fog season.

## [WPN-ASN-F-003] Sablecord Garrote — F

Type/Slot: Flexible garrote / Main hand | Class: Assassin | Lv Req: 6

Base Stats: ATK 9

Bonus Stats: +1 AGI, +1 SEN

Effect: **Snare the Sleeve** — a successful hit on an enemy not currently targeting you reduces its movement speed by 5% for 2 seconds. Cooldown: 12 seconds. Bosses are immune to the slow.

Requirements: Assassin class; minimum AGI 6 and SEN 5. Requires close range; cannot be used while holding a shield or two-handed weapon.

Set: None.

Binding/Durability: Tradable; 55/55 durability.

Source: Quest reward for “The Bellmaker's Missing Coil” in Old Bellmarket; uncommon salvage from the Black Thread smugglers.

Lore: The cord is braided from dark plant fiber around a fine metal strand, flexible enough to coil inside a sleeve. Its maker warns that restraint and judgment matter more than strength.

## [WPN-ASN-F-004] Mothglass Stiletto — F

Type/Slot: Stiletto / Main hand | Class: Assassin | Lv Req: 8

Base Stats: ATK 11

Bonus Stats: +2 AGI, +1 LUK

Effect: **Seam Finder** — deals +8% damage to an enemy wearing light armor. Does not affect unarmored enemies, shields, or heavy armor.

Requirements: Assassin class; minimum AGI 8. Precision weapon; heavy attacks have a 10% longer recovery.

Set: None.

Binding/Durability: Tradable; 50/50 durability.

Source: Drop from the Mothglass prowler in the undercroft of Lumen House; also available for a one-time token exchange at the market's night stall.

Lore: Its translucent gray hilt is made from fired glassstone, not actual glass, and its narrow point is meant to find gaps rather than force them. In moonlight, the blade seems to lose its outline.

## [WPN-ASN-F-005] Backstep Crescent — F

Type/Slot: Curved short sword / Main hand | Class: Assassin | Lv Req: 10

Base Stats: ATK 14

Bonus Stats: +2 AGI, +1 SEN

Effect: **Parting Arc** — after a successful dodge, your next basic attack within 1.5 seconds deals +8% damage. Cooldown: 10 seconds; does not stack with other Parting Arc effects.

Requirements: Assassin class; minimum AGI 9 and SEN 5.

Set: None.

Binding/Durability: Tradable; 55/55 durability.

Source: Final reward from the “No Footprints in Snow” guildless trial at Froststep Yard.

Lore: The blade curves back toward the hand, its shape inspired by the crescent trail left by a boot in fresh snow. Candidates earn it only after crossing the yard without disturbing its rows of hanging bells.

## Rank F — Weapons — Ranger

*Ranger weapon identity: ranged arms emphasizing aim, spacing, and reliable field use. F-rank weapon ATK range: 5–15.*

## [WPN-RNG-F-001] Alderwhistle Longbow — F

Type/Slot: Longbow / Two-handed ranged weapon | Class: Ranger | Lv Req: 2

Base Stats: ATK 9

Bonus Stats: +1 AGI, +1 SEN

Effect: **Clear Lane** — shots against targets at least 8 meters away gain +5% accuracy. No bonus applies inside 8 meters.

Requirements: Ranger class; minimum AGI 5 and SEN 4; requires arrows and both hands.

Set: None.

Binding/Durability: Tradable; 70/70 durability.

Source: Starter fletcher in Mossford; common reward for the Alder March scouting board.

Lore: Made from springy alder and strung with waxed reed-fiber, it gives a soft whistle when drawn to full tension. Rangers use that note to judge whether the bow is ready before taking a shot in poor light.

## [WPN-RNG-F-002] Reedrunner Shortbow — F

Type/Slot: Shortbow / Two-handed ranged weapon | Class: Ranger | Lv Req: 4

Base Stats: ATK 8

Bonus Stats: +2 AGI

Effect: **Quick Nock** — after a successful dodge, the next basic shot is released 5% faster. Cooldown: 8 seconds; does not change the global attack limit.

Requirements: Ranger class; minimum AGI 6; requires arrows and both hands.

Set: None.

Binding/Durability: Tradable; 65/65 durability.

Source: Crafted at Reedbank from marshwood and a fletcher's wax; also a quest reward for delivering the ferry's lost gear.

Lore: Its compact limbs are wrapped in green thread so a scout can find the bow quickly in wet grass. The ferry wardens prize it for the speed with which it can be brought to bear from a crouch.

## [WPN-RNG-F-003] Thistlemark Light Crossbow — F

Type/Slot: Light crossbow / Two-handed ranged weapon | Class: Ranger | Lv Req: 6

Base Stats: ATK 12

Bonus Stats: +1 SEN, +1 LUK

Effect: **Pinned Hem** — a hit on a non-boss enemy has a 6% chance to reduce movement speed by 5% for 2 seconds. Cooldown: 12 seconds per target.

Requirements: Ranger class; minimum SEN 6; requires bolts and both hands. Reloading takes 1.2 seconds.

Set: None.

Binding/Durability: Tradable; 60/60 durability.

Source: Reward for the “Thistlefield Watch” contract; bolts sold separately by the field quartermaster.

Lore: The stock is carved with a line of tiny thistles, one for each season the watch has stood. The mechanism is simple enough to repair with a common pin and a patient hand.

## [WPN-RNG-F-004] Farlook Slingstaff — F

Type/Slot: Slingstaff / Two-handed ranged weapon | Class: Ranger | Lv Req: 8

Base Stats: ATK 10

Bonus Stats: +1 AGI, +2 SEN

Effect: **Arc Reader** — after aiming for 1 second without moving, your next shot gains +8% accuracy. The bonus ends on firing or moving.

Requirements: Ranger class; minimum SEN 7; requires sling stones or compatible pellets and both hands.

Set: None.

Binding/Durability: Tradable; 60/60 durability.

Source: Sold by the Farlook observatory's supply cart after completing its beginner marksmanship lesson.

Lore: A forked staff with a reinforced pocket, it can launch smooth stones farther than its humble construction suggests. Observatory scouts use it to test wind direction by watching the first shot's curve.

## [WPN-RNG-F-005] Crowflight Hunting Bow — F

Type/Slot: Recurve bow / Two-handed ranged weapon | Class: Ranger | Lv Req: 10

Base Stats: ATK 15

Bonus Stats: +2 AGI, +1 SEN

Effect: **Marked Quarry** — after observing a creature for 2 seconds from at least 10 meters away, your first shot against it deals +8% damage. Mark lasts 10 seconds; cooldown: 20 seconds.

Requirements: Ranger class; minimum AGI 8 and SEN 6; requires arrows and both hands.

Set: None.

Binding/Durability: Tradable; 55/55 durability.

Source: Reward for the level-10 “Crowflight Census” field quest; rare sale from the seasonal hunt fair.

Lore: The bow's dark limbs are laminated from three local woods, each selected for a different part of the draw. Its name honors the crows that led the first census takers to safe paths through the bracken.

---

## Rank F — Weapons — Mage

*Mage weapon identity: arcane foci for shaping and directing spellwork rather than replacing a mage's discipline. F-rank weapon ATK range: 5–15; magical focus power is listed separately where relevant.*

## [WPN-MAG-F-001] Cinderwick Staff — F

Type/Slot: Staff / Two-handed focus | Class: Mage | Lv Req: 2

Base Stats: ATK 6; MP +4

Bonus Stats: +2 INT

Effect: **Kindled Channel** — fire spells cost 2% less MP, to a minimum reduction of 1 MP. Passive; does not reduce item or ritual costs.

Requirements: Mage class; minimum INT 5; both hands required.

Set: None.

Binding/Durability: Tradable; 70/70 durability.

Source: Sold by the Emberlane academy's introductory supply desk; common drop from ash-sprites.

Lore: A knotted hazel shaft holds a bead of kiln glass that warms when a spell is prepared. Apprentices are told that a steady ember is safer than a spectacular flame.

## [WPN-MAG-F-002] Bluehush Wand — F

Type/Slot: Wand / Main hand | Class: Mage | Lv Req: 4

Base Stats: ATK 8; MP +3

Bonus Stats: +2 INT, +1 SEN

Effect: **Quiet Focus** — the first spell cast after remaining out of combat for 5 seconds costs 1 less MP. Cooldown: 20 seconds.

Requirements: Mage class; minimum INT 6.

Set: None.

Binding/Durability: Tradable; 65/65 durability.

Source: Crafted by the Bluehush glasswright using river crystal; also given for completing the academy's “Listen Before Casting” lesson.

Lore: The blue core contains a trapped bubble that never rises, even when the wand is turned. Its quietness is considered a useful lesson: magic begins with attention, not noise.

## [WPN-MAG-F-003] Folded Star Primer — F

Type/Slot: Spell tome / Off-hand focus | Class: Mage | Lv Req: 6

Base Stats: ATK 5; MP +6

Bonus Stats: +2 INT

Effect: **Margin Note** — after casting a non-damaging spell, your next damaging spell within 6 seconds gains +4% accuracy. Cooldown: 12 seconds.

Requirements: Mage class; minimum INT 7; requires one hand free to turn pages; cannot be used with a shield.

Set: None.

Binding/Durability: Tradable; 50/50 durability.

Source: Quest reward from the Scriptorium of Nine Lamps; additional copies are rare finds in scholar satchels.

Lore: The primer's pages fold into a star when opened to the center, revealing handwritten notes from generations of novice mages. Several margins are still blank, waiting for a careful reader.

## [WPN-MAG-F-004] Rainwell Orb — F

Type/Slot: Orb / Off-hand focus | Class: Mage | Lv Req: 8

Base Stats: ATK 9; MP +5

Bonus Stats: +2 INT, +1 VIT

Effect: **Gathered Dew** — while standing in natural rain, recover 1 MP every 30 seconds, up to 3 MP per encounter. Does not function indoors or in conjured weather.

Requirements: Mage class; minimum INT 8; occupies the off-hand.

Set: None.

Binding/Durability: Tradable; 55/55 durability.

Source: Drop from the Rainwell wisp in the lower cistern; also exchanged for three rain-glass shards at the local apothecary.

Lore: A cloudy sphere turns clear at its center when rain falls nearby. Cistern keepers say it remembers the first storm that filled the well after a decade of drought.

## [WPN-MAG-F-005] Chalkline Rod — F

Type/Slot: Focus rod / Main hand | Class: Mage | Lv Req: 10

Base Stats: ATK 12; MP +4

Bonus Stats: +2 INT, +1 SEN

Effect: **Measured Sigil** — spells with a stationary casting time of at least 1 second gain +5% effect duration. Does not increase damage or affect instant spells.

Requirements: Mage class; minimum INT 9 and SEN 5.

Set: None.

Binding/Durability: Tradable; 55/55 durability.

Source: Final reward for “The Three Chalk Circles” at Emberlane's public practice hall.

Lore: A pale mineral rod with three dark rings, it was designed to help students keep a spell's geometry aligned. Its former owner wrote one rule on the grip: measure twice, release once.

---

## Rank F — Weapons — Cleric

*Cleric weapon identity: simple arms and sacred foci that support protection, restoration, and steady frontline presence. F-rank weapon ATK range: 5–15.*

## [WPN-CLR-F-001] Dawnbell Mace — F

Type/Slot: One-handed mace / Main hand | Class: Cleric | Lv Req: 2

Base Stats: ATK 8; MP +2

Bonus Stats: +1 VIT, +1 INT

Effect: **Gentle Reprieve** — after restoring an ally's HP, your next basic attack within 5 seconds deals +5% damage. Cooldown: 12 seconds.

Requirements: Cleric class; minimum INT 4 and VIT 4; one hand free.

Set: None.

Binding/Durability: Tradable; 75/75 durability.

Source: Issued by the Dawnbell Hospice to new field attendants; also a common reward for its gathering errands.

Lore: A small bronze bell is set inside the mace head, giving a soft note when its bearer moves. Hospice clerics say the sound reminds them to arrive calmly, even when the road is not.

## [WPN-CLR-F-002] Vowreed Scepter — F

Type/Slot: Scepter / Main hand | Class: Cleric | Lv Req: 4

Base Stats: ATK 7; MP +5

Bonus Stats: +2 INT

Effect: **Kept Promise** — the first protective spell cast after entering combat grants its target +1 DEF for 3 seconds. Cooldown: 20 seconds.

Requirements: Cleric class; minimum INT 6.

Set: None.

Binding/Durability: Tradable; 65/65 durability.

Source: Crafted from vowreed and a brass setting at the Reedbank sanctuary; recipe awarded for completing a healing-practice quest.

Lore: The reed grows only where the sanctuary's spring reaches the marsh. Each scepter bears a short promise chosen by its maker, engraved small enough to be read only by its bearer.

## [WPN-CLR-F-003] Candleward Flail — F

Type/Slot: One-handed devotional flail / Main hand | Class: Cleric | Lv Req: 6

Base Stats: ATK 10; MP +3

Bonus Stats: +1 STR, +1 VIT

Effect: **Ward Tap** — hitting an enemy that is attacking an ally grants that ally +1 DEF for 2 seconds. Cooldown: 14 seconds; only one ally can benefit per trigger.

Requirements: Cleric class; minimum VIT 6; one hand free.

Set: None.

Binding/Durability: Tradable; 65/65 durability.

Source: Reward for the “Lanterns at the Ford” escort quest; uncommon drop from ford raiders.

Lore: Its head is wrapped in a short chain of prayer beads that chime on impact. The flail was made for wardens who needed a practical weapon without setting aside the rites of their order.

## [WPN-CLR-F-004] Stillwater Reliquary — F

Type/Slot: Handheld relic focus / Off-hand | Class: Cleric | Lv Req: 8

Base Stats: ATK 5; MP +7

Bonus Stats: +2 INT, +1 SEN

Effect: **Calm Current** — healing spells restore an additional 1 HP to targets below 50% HP. Triggers once per target every 15 seconds; does not affect overhealing.

Requirements: Cleric class; minimum INT 8; occupies the off-hand; cannot be equipped with a shield.

Set: None.

Binding/Durability: Tradable; 50/50 durability.

Source: Found in the sealed spring room beneath Stillwater Chapel; chapel key is awarded after the “Restore the Flow” quest.

Lore: A drop of springwater sits suspended within a thumb-sized crystal reliquary. It has never spilled, though the old chapel has survived floods, fires, and one very determined thief.

## [WPN-CLR-F-005] Hearthlit Warstaff — F

Type/Slot: Two-handed staff / Main hand | Class: Cleric | Lv Req: 10

Base Stats: ATK 13; MP +5

Bonus Stats: +2 VIT, +1 INT

Effect: **Shelter's Reach** — while channeling a protective spell, gain +1 DEF. Ends when channeling ends; cooldown: 10 seconds after the effect ends.

Requirements: Cleric class; minimum VIT 8 and INT 6; both hands required.

Set: None.

Binding/Durability: Tradable; 60/60 durability.

Source: Final reward from the Hearthlit Refuge's “Stand Through the Storm” trial.

Lore: Its ashwood shaft is capped with a small lantern cage that holds a harmless golden flame. The refuge's keepers pass it to those who have learned that shelter is something a person does, not merely a place.

## Rank F — Weapons — Summoner

*Summoner weapon identity: attunement tools that help call, direct, and sustain summoned companions without replacing the summoner's own resource limits. F-rank weapon ATK range: 5–15.*

## [WPN-SUM-F-001] Thimblebell Conduit — F

Type/Slot: Conduit staff / Two-handed focus | Class: Summoner | Lv Req: 2

Base Stats: ATK 5; MP +6

Bonus Stats: +2 INT

Effect: **Caller's Rhythm** — after summoning a companion, gain +1 SEN for 5 seconds. Cooldown: 20 seconds.

Requirements: Summoner class; minimum INT 5; both hands required.

Set: None.

Binding/Durability: Tradable; 65/65 durability.

Source: Sold by the Threadmarket familiar-supply stall; common reward for the first companion-bonding lesson.

Lore: A tiny bronze bell hangs inside the crook of its staff, ringing only when a summon answers. Apprentice callers learn to wait for that note instead of forcing a second command.

## [WPN-SUM-F-002] Bondweft Focus — F

Type/Slot: Wrist focus / Off-hand | Class: Summoner | Lv Req: 4

Base Stats: ATK 6; MP +4

Bonus Stats: +1 INT, +1 VIT

Effect: **Tethered Attention** — your first command issued to a summoned companion in combat costs 1 less MP. Cooldown: 20 seconds; cannot reduce a cost below 1 MP.

Requirements: Summoner class; minimum INT 6; occupies one wrist/off-hand slot; no shield may be equipped in that slot.

Set: None.

Binding/Durability: Tradable; 55/55 durability.

Source: Crafted by the Threadmarket weavers from bondweft silk and a riverstone clasp; recipe unlocked by the “Gentle Tether” quest.

Lore: Its braided fibers tighten slightly when a companion is near, then relax when the summon departs. Weavers insist it is a reminder of connection, not a leash.

## [WPN-SUM-F-003] Pocket Menagerie Codex — F

Type/Slot: Summoner's codex / Off-hand focus | Class: Summoner | Lv Req: 6

Base Stats: ATK 5; MP +7

Bonus Stats: +2 INT, +1 SEN

Effect: **Name Remembered** — once per encounter, the first time you summon a companion, it gains +1 DEF for 3 seconds. Does not stack with another Name Remembered effect.

Requirements: Summoner class; minimum INT 7; requires one hand free to turn pages; cannot be used with a shield.

Set: None.

Binding/Durability: Tradable; 45/45 durability.

Source: Quest reward from the Menagerie Annex after completing three care tasks for resident summons.

Lore: Its pages contain sketches of small spirits, each labeled with a name supplied by a different apprentice. Several have been crossed out and lovingly rewritten after their subjects changed shape.

## [WPN-SUM-F-004] Hearthseed Orb — F

Type/Slot: Orb / Main hand focus | Class: Summoner | Lv Req: 8

Base Stats: ATK 8; MP +5

Bonus Stats: +2 INT, +1 VIT

Effect: **Warm Return** — when a summoned companion returns to its realm normally, restore 1 MP. Triggers once per 30 seconds; does not trigger if forcibly dismissed or defeated.

Requirements: Summoner class; minimum INT 8; one hand required to channel through the orb.

Set: None.

Binding/Durability: Tradable; 55/55 durability.

Source: Drop from the Hearthseed wisp nest in the lower conservatory; also traded for five uncracked seedstones.

Lore: A dull green sphere holds a fleck of amber light that brightens near living roots. Conservatory keepers believe it was formed when a homesick garden spirit left a spark behind.

## [WPN-SUM-F-005] Waycaller's Fork — F

Type/Slot: Two-pronged calling rod / Main hand focus | Class: Summoner | Lv Req: 10

Base Stats: ATK 11; MP +6

Bonus Stats: +2 INT, +1 SEN

Effect: **Clear Command** — the first command given to a companion at least 6 meters away has +5% command accuracy. Cooldown: 15 seconds.

Requirements: Summoner class; minimum INT 9 and SEN 5; requires an unobstructed line of sight to the companion.

Set: None.

Binding/Durability: Tradable; 50/50 durability.

Source: Reward for the level-10 “Call Across the Ravine” trial at Waycross Academy.

Lore: The forked tip separates two threads of pale light when a command is sent, helping novices see whether their intent reached its mark. Experienced callers learn to trust the answer, not the glow.

## Rank F — Weapons — Monk

*Monk weapon identity: close-range implements and training tools that reward timing, balance, and controlled technique. F-rank weapon ATK range: 5–15.*

## [WPN-MNK-F-001] Quietstep Knuckle Wraps — F

Type/Slot: Paired hand wraps / Both hands | Class: Monk | Lv Req: 2

Base Stats: ATK 5 each (10 combined across a two-hand technique; each strike is calculated separately)

Bonus Stats: +1 AGI, +1 VIT

Effect: **Soft Landing** — after a successful dodge, the next unarmed or wrap strike within 2 seconds gains +4% accuracy. Cooldown: 8 seconds.

Requirements: Monk class; minimum AGI 4 and VIT 4; both hands required. Does not increase attack speed.

Set: None.

Binding/Durability: Tradable; 50/50 durability.

Source: Issued by the Quietstep Hall to new students; replacement wraps are sold by the hall's quartermaster.

Lore: These plain linen wraps are stitched with a single gray line that disappears beneath the palm. Students are taught that the first lesson is not how to strike, but how to arrive without making the floor answer.

## [WPN-MNK-F-002] Riverturn Staff — F

Type/Slot: Quarterstaff / Two-handed | Class: Monk | Lv Req: 4

Base Stats: ATK 9

Bonus Stats: +1 AGI, +1 SEN

Effect: **Redirecting Palm** — after a successful block or deflection with the staff, gain +1 DEF for 2 seconds. Cooldown: 10 seconds.

Requirements: Monk class; minimum AGI 5 and SEN 4; both hands required.

Set: None.

Binding/Durability: Tradable; 70/70 durability.

Source: Crafted from river ash by the Reedbank training hall; also awarded for completing the “Three Turns of Water” form lesson.

Lore: The staff is polished smooth by repeated practice in shallow water, where every clumsy motion throws a visible wake. Its maker leaves one natural knot intact as a reminder that strength need not mean rigidity.

## [WPN-MNK-F-003] Bellstone Tonfa — F

Type/Slot: Paired tonfa / Main hand and off hand | Class: Monk | Lv Req: 6

Base Stats: ATK 6 each (12 combined when both strikes hit; each tonfa is calculated separately)

Bonus Stats: +1 VIT, +1 SEN

Effect: **Guarded Turn** — after a successful block with a tonfa, your next strike within 2 seconds deals +5% damage. Cooldown: 10 seconds.

Requirements: Monk class; minimum VIT 6 and SEN 5; both hands required and both tonfa must be equipped.

Set: None.

Binding/Durability: Tradable as a pair or individually; 60/60 durability per tonfa.

Source: Reward from Bellstone Yard's introductory sparring ladder; uncommon drop from its practice guardians.

Lore: Dense pale stone is caged in a simple iron frame at each handle's end. Their faint chime is not decoration: instructors use it to hear when a student's guard has drifted out of alignment.

## [WPN-MNK-F-004] Cloudheel Chain — F

Type/Slot: Short weighted chain / Main hand | Class: Monk | Lv Req: 8

Base Stats: ATK 10

Bonus Stats: +2 AGI, +1 SEN

Effect: **Catch the Step** — a successful hit against a moving non-boss target reduces its movement speed by 5% for 1 second. Cooldown: 12 seconds per target.

Requirements: Monk class; minimum AGI 7 and SEN 5; one hand free. Ineffective against targets immune to movement effects.

Set: None.

Binding/Durability: Tradable; 55/55 durability.

Source: Earned by completing the Cloudheel courtyard's moving-target course; also sold during the spring martial fair.

Lore: Small cloud-shaped weights are spaced along its dark cord, making the chain easier to read by touch during a spin. The courtyard's old teacher used it to teach students that pursuit and control are not the same thing.

## [WPN-MNK-F-005] Stillpoint Bracers — F

Type/Slot: Paired forearm bracers / Both arms, weapon slot | Class: Monk | Lv Req: 10

Base Stats: ATK 12

Bonus Stats: +2 VIT, +1 AGI

Effect: **Rooted Breath** — after standing still for 1 second, gain +1 DEF until you move or attack, up to 3 seconds. Cooldown: 12 seconds.

Requirements: Monk class; minimum VIT 8 and AGI 5; both bracers equipped. The effect ends immediately upon movement or attack.

Set: None.

Binding/Durability: Tradable as a pair; 55/55 durability per bracer.

Source: Final reward for the level-10 Stillpoint Hall balance examination; not available from ordinary vendors.

Lore: Their inner plates are made of layered reedsteel and fitted close to the forearm, leaving the hands free. The examination's final bell is struck only when the student can stand without mistaking stillness for fear.

# Dual Swordsman Class Expansion

**Class identity:** A dedicated dual-blade specialist built around paired weapon handling, alternating attack lines, recovery timing, and maintaining pressure without sacrificing control. Dual Swordsman is a separate class; its weapons and armor are class-restricted to Dual Swordsman unless an item explicitly states otherwise.

**Above-average rule:** Within each rank, Dual Swordsman items target the upper portion of that rank’s stat band and offer more deliberate class synergy than general items. They still remain within the published ATK/DEF ceilings, require that rank’s level band, and never exceed the next rank’s baseline in raw stats. Effects are strong but bounded by cooldowns, target conditions, or encounter limits. Set bonuses focus on paired strikes, blade transitions, and defensive recovery rather than unlimited extra attacks.

**Expansion scope:** For each rank F through SSS, add 5 Dual Swordsman weapons, 5 full sets per armor type (cloth, leather, plate/heavy), 8 accessories, 8 consumables, and 5 cosmetics. Armor sets have 2-, 4-, and 5-piece thresholds. Materials and crafting components remain out of scope unless requested.

## Rank F — Dual Swordsman Weapons

*Five class-exclusive weapons. F-rank ATK band: 5–15; level band: Lv 1–10. Paired weapons list each blade’s ATK separately; combined ATK does not create extra attacks.*

### [WPN-DWS-F-001] First-Step Twinblades — F

Type/Slot: Matched paired short swords / Main hand and off hand | Class: Dual Swordsman | Lv Req: 2

Base Stats: ATK 7 each (14 combined when both strikes hit; each blade is calculated separately)

Bonus Stats: +2 AGI, +1 SEN

Effect: **Alternating Edge** — if the two blades hit the same target within 1.5 seconds, the second hit gains +8% accuracy. Cooldown: 8 seconds; does not grant an extra attack.

Requirements: Dual Swordsman class; minimum AGI 5 and SEN 4; both hands and both blades required.

Set: None.

Binding/Durability: Tradable as a pair; 65/65 durability per blade.

Source: Reward for the Mossford paired-weapon balance examination.

Lore: The short blades are deliberately plain, with one brass dot on the left guard and two on the right. Their maker teaches that a pair is not two copies, but two answers to the same opening.

### [WPN-DWS-F-002] Reedwind Crossing Pair — F

Type/Slot: Matched paired sabers / Main hand and off hand | Class: Dual Swordsman | Lv Req: 4

Base Stats: ATK 6 each (12 combined when both strikes hit; each blade is calculated separately)

Bonus Stats: +2 AGI, +1 VIT

Effect: **Crossing Current** — after a successful dodge, the next hit with either blade gains +6% damage. Cooldown: 10 seconds.

Requirements: Dual Swordsman class; minimum AGI 6 and VIT 4; both hands required.

Set: None.

Binding/Durability: Tradable as a pair; 60/60 durability per blade.

Source: Crafted at Reedbank from marsh ash and matched iron; recipe unlocked by the “Two Reeds, One Current” form lesson.

Lore: Their shallow curves are mirror-matched but not identical, helping the wielder distinguish each blade by feel. Reedbank instructors use them to teach clean transitions rather than forceful clashes.

### [WPN-DWS-F-003] Bellstep Guardblades — F

Type/Slot: Paired short swords / Main hand and off hand | Class: Dual Swordsman | Lv Req: 6

Base Stats: ATK 8 each (16 combined when both strikes hit; each blade is calculated separately)

Bonus Stats: +1 AGI, +1 VIT

Effect: **Guarded Return** — after a successful deflection with either blade, gain +1 DEF for 2 seconds. Cooldown: 12 seconds.

Requirements: Dual Swordsman class; minimum AGI 5 and VIT 5; both hands required.

Set: None.

Binding/Durability: Tradable as a pair; 55/55 durability per blade.

Source: Bellstrand watch’s paired-blade sparring ladder; uncommon reward for placing in the top three.

Lore: A raised ridge on each blade’s spine helps catch a strike without turning the edge into a shield. The paired bells on their hilts ring at different pitches, marking which hand has returned to guard.

### [WPN-DWS-F-004] Foxfire Twinpoints — F

Type/Slot: Matched paired thrusting swords / Main hand and off hand | Class: Dual Swordsman | Lv Req: 8
